real_local_source_conclusion.not_implied: Kernel fact realness, PG session success or review PASS does not independently accept source. Prospective accepted lineage must be checked as that lineage, never mislabeled historical frozen membership.
real_local_source_conclusion.no_new_root: Existing acceptedRoot identity/semantics unchanged. Prospective accepted-source record under existing gate is not a new signing authority; if implementation needs new authority/key trust origin, it has exceeded this path.
real_local_source_conclusion.basis: Mandate permits local real acquisition/test entities and automatic distinct qualification/acceptance; existing prospective path explicitly separates new acceptance from historical root

exact_existing_bindings.generation: Exact high-water/entity revision/tip and tombstone predicates exist; actual current root state cannot be inferred from first nonzero generation

exact_existing_bindings.challenge: Native registry one_use and identity codec typed challenge/purpose_work_id encodings exist; actual fresh one-use state must be measured under approved NEW qualification

last_uncreatable_fact.conditional: After authorized resolver/owner/PAIR/bootstrap engineering and actual independent local measurement, the remaining gate may require independently approved expected manifest and actual issuer/acceptance-controller binding to exact source/context/version, rooted in existing authority.
last_uncreatable_fact.minimum_if_unavailable: Supply/bind existing authorized HOST/DEPLOYMENT provisioning and separately controlled acceptance executor with exact protected expected manifest/source lineage; no new root keys/authority and no broad production access.
last_uncreatable_fact.why: Agent cannot manufacture protected custody/approved issuer, claim historical membership or let creator control approving path. Existing test harness generates TEST_ONLY_NONCANONICAL ED25519 material with policy_authority NONE; that cannot fill this requirement.
last_uncreatable_fact.not_proven_hard_stop: No exhaustive proof that legitimately available bindings cannot be obtained in current authorized environment. Thus do not stop engineering or request generic authority now.
